text:
Maya Chen: Quick UX flag from support: customers confused about bulk revoke and empty state for API keys. Screenshot + repro: https://img.redwood/snap/keys-bulk-1.png
Zoe Park: Seen this too. In the keys empty state the CTAs say "Create key" and "Learn more" but users expect a sample command (cli) to get started. Can we add a ready-to-run snippet?
Luis Fernandez: Bulk revoke UX: right now we show a full-width red banner "Revoking keys" after selecting >1 key. Problem: no per-key feedback. Ops reported one customer had 2/5 revoked and the UI still said success.
Priya Raman: Agree. Need per-key status rows after bulk action (revoked, skipped, failed). For failures show reason and a retry per-key action.
Jamie Ortiz: Accessibility & copy: banner text needs to be shorter for mobile. Also the banner background contrast is okay for WCAG AA but the white icon on red is marginal on small displays. We should use a thicker icon and ensure 4.5:1 contrast for icons+text.
Maya Chen: Proposal: Replace single banner with an inline toast that summarizes results + expandable list for details. Example: "Bulk revoke complete — 3 revoked, 2 failed. View details." Expand shows per-key rows with status and microcopy.
Zoe Park: For empty state add two code examples side-by-side: curl + node SDK. Example CURL snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -d '{"name":"dev-key","scopes":["inference:generate"]}'
```
Luis Fernandez: On permissions: some users with 'read-only' role can still see 'Revoke' CTA in the dropdown due to frontend check bug. Need to hide destructive actions entirely for users missing write scope.
Priya Raman: Also call out audit trail: bulk revoke should annotate which account initiated each revoke and whether it was via API or UI. That helps SREs trace incidents.
Jamie Ortiz: Keyboard flow for bulk action: after hitting Revoke selected -> focus should move to the confirm modal, first interactive element should be the "Confirm revoke" button or the reason input if present. If the modal contains details, set focus to the modal heading then tab into controls. Also announce via aria-live the start and result of the job.
Maya Chen: Copy suggestions: change CTA from "Revoke selected" to "Revoke selected keys" (explicit). Confirmation dialog heading: "Revoke X API keys?" Body: "This will immediately stop any service using these keys from authenticating. This action cannot be undone. Consider rotating keys instead if you can coordinate deploys." Buttons: Primary = "Confirm revoke", secondary = "Cancel".
Zoe Park: For failed items show inline help link "Why did this fail?" that explains common reasons (key in use by dedicated infra, key already expired, permission denied).
Luis Fernandez: Backend can return structured failures. Example response: ```json
{
  "revoked": 3,
  "failed": 2,
  "errors": [
    {"key_id":"k_12","reason":"in_use"},
    {"key_id":"k_34","reason":"permission_denied"}
  ]
}
```
Maya Chen: Ops-bot can you open a ticket to track UI + accessibility + backend changes?
ops-bot: Created PROD-1456: "Keys: bulk revoke UX improvements, empty state code snippets, permissions visibility fixes" assigned to @Zoe, @Luis, @Jamie. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-1456
Priya Raman: I'll add acceptance criteria: 1) hide revoke CTA for read-only roles, 2) show per-key results after bulk operations, 3) empty state includes runnable curl + SDK snippet, 4) aria-live announcements for start/result, 5) updated icon contrast and mobile banner sizing.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. Zoe/Jamie can you mock the empty state with snippets and the expanded result panel? Luis & Priya can spec the API error format and permission gating. We'll review in next product sync. :raised_hands:
